parsed.name: 是德科技 N777x 可调谐激光模块
parsed.description: N777x 是一款用于光通信与光子学实验的可调谐激光模块，可在一定波长范围内提供稳定激光输出，并支持功率调节、步进或连续波长扫描以及触发同步，常用于光器件表征、插损测试和扫波测量。
parsed.description_en: The N777x is a tunable laser module for optical communications and photonics laboratories. It provides stable laser output over a selectable wavelength range and supports power control, stepped or continuous wavelength sweeps, and trigger synchronization for tasks such as optical component characterization, insertion-loss testing, and swept-wavelength measurements.
